title: ON GARDENING // ColorBlaze Sunset coleus creates dream gardens | | timesdaily.com
text:
There is an annual bedding plant that dazzles in the shade or the sun. It is among the last plants planted each year, as if it were placed at the back of the line. But from the hottest days of summer to the cool days of fall, your eyes are drawn to its beauty. It is the ColorBlaze Sedona Sunset coleus.
